entries.title: Nature scene roster — moon and conifers replaced
entries.note: Scenes 6/7/16 changed from night sky, pine forest and winter pines to drifting clouds, mossy river stones and snowfall over drifts (hard silhouettes and a near-black field do not work behind tile content). The behaviors/appearance/background 'default' note still lists the old three by name. Note-add is ADDITIVE, so the stale note must be removed on the tile before re-sending, or the roster lands twice.

entries.title: Presentation outcomes toolchain — annotations, pronunciations, teaser, posts, publisher
entries.note: Shipped this session with NO mirror: the annotation feature (highlight text -> file a note against a scene), pronunciations.json as spoken-form rules, [pause] as narration direction, the teaser and post-series cutters, the LinkedIn feed preview, and publish-linkedin.cjs. Wants a collection under behaviors (or a new 'outcomes' root) with one part tile per source file, plus notes explaining the chunk model: instructions on tiles compile to a page, audio cached by spoken form, an idea branch carries outcomes as decorations. This is also the design seed for the visual:outcome:linkedin view behaviour Jaime asked for -- mirror it before building it.

entries.title: Mirror the notes view's identity plate + navigator hover peek
entries.note: Two new parts of the notes strip need tiles under the notes-view creation: (1) the IDENTITY PLATE — the tile's own hexagon (picture via props -> small.image), name, explorer path and counts (notes / questions / answers / child tiles), with a compact form below 400px panel width and a masthead form in fullscreen; (2) the NAVIGATOR HOVER PEEK — hovering a tile chip lists that tile's notes in a card beside the rail, flipping side by available room. Mark each tile 'part'; both read state the panel already warms, so the notes explain WHY there is no extra read. Files: hypercomb-shared/ui/notes-strip/{notes-strip.component.ts,.html,.scss}.

entries.title: Views window shows views beside itself; panels survive full-screen
entries.note: Behaviour changed, no mirror pass run (no live bridge this session). Owed under behaviors/views: (1) update the 'views' window cell's notes — clicking a row SHOWS that view in the container and the window stays open, one at a time, on-rows first with Active/Inactive filters; (2) a part tile for the inset contract — every full-screen view surface reads --hc-inset-left/--hc-inset-right (the CSS mirror of viewport:inset), so a docked toolwindow sits beside the view; (3) a note on the pheromones (tags) window cell: it now opens INSIDE a full-screen view — the dev shell's view-website sweep no longer hides hc-shell-surfaces, and the views panel moved to the shared toolwindow layer z 100002. Files: hypercomb-shared/ui/views-viewer/*, hypercomb-dev/src/app/app.scss, presentation/tiles/{tree,site,slides,living-brief,view-library}*.ts, tutorial/tutor-view.drone.ts, workflow/workflow-view.drone.ts.

entries.title: Mirror the bouquet-organised pheromone panel (bouquets > loose > namespaces)
entries.note: tags-viewer restructured so bouquets are the organising unit; new tag-grouping.ts holds the set-not-a-folder rule (gathered marks leave the loose list, namespaced marks never leave their namespace). mirror-bouquets.ts reconciles behaviors/views/tags/{bouquet-registry,tags-viewer.component} — its existing note is now stale, and tag-grouping.ts needs a new part tile. Bridge broker was up and a renderer was registered, but ops timed out (cold/unresponsive renderer tab).

entries.title: Cell pages are artifacts — page CSS scoped to its own host
entries.note: No mirror pass run (no live bridge). Owed under behaviors/views/website: a part tile for cell-page-css-scope.ts with a note explaining the artifact rule — a page carries its own CSS inside its host, page roots (html/body/:root) map onto the host, and class/data-theme are mirrored onto the host so in-page theme toggles keep working; external <link> sheets stay in head and are the one thing that cannot travel. Ties to the standing doctrine 'every render is an artifact — displayable alone or together'. Files: presentation/tiles/cell-page-css-scope.ts (+ .spec.ts), presentation/tiles/site-view.drone.ts, documentation/embedded-sites.md.
